    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.86, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 2.05 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=5.23, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 9.55 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 2.05 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.32, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 7.52 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.46, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 5.08 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.08, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 6.2 * vars['Var_5']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints

    m.addConstr(3.31 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.62 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.18 * vars['Var_4'] + 9.65 * vars['Var_7'] <= 96.18, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(3.86 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.1 * vars['Var_5'] <= 75.88, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(0.58 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.48 * vars['Var_3'] <= 29.58, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(6.95 * vars['Var_2'] + 9.57 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.34 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.87 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.13 * vars['Var_7'] <= 138.17, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(9.53 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.37 * vars['Var_1'] + 3.47 * vars['Var_3'] <= 97.0, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(7.89 * vars['Var_3'] + 9.96 * vars['Var_7'] <= 45.14, name='C7')
